generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by any State Government/Government of India/Union Territory

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidder end
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees as per e-portal.
The tender is of two cover system
The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which, the bids are liable for disqualification
Rates shall be quoted in Tender Schedule-B (Financial Bid) in the website itself
For those tenderers whose Technical bids satisfy the eligibility criteria and who has furnished all the necessary documents, only their financial Bids will be opened
The tender document is part and parcel of the agreement

KPCL reserves the right to verify any information/documents furnished by the tenderer should the circumstances so warrant. In case the information or the documents furnished are found to be incorrect/false or invalid then the EMD furnished by such tenderer shall be forfeited. The registration of such tenderer shall also be cancelled
Right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons rests with the accepting authority
The successful bidders shall give an undertaking that they would abide by the provisions of the Employee Provident Fund Act
The contractor shall obtain insurance coverage for all the workers working in this area

The bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST but inclusive of all applicable taxes), levies, duties and Cess, building worker welfare Cess (if applicable) etc., as per the latest GOK and Government of India prevailing as on the date of NIT.
The Bidder shall quote his rates inclusive of PF as per the applicable rates as issued by the PF Department from time to time

The bidder should take into account the prevailing royalty charges while quoting their rates and submit the Material Dispatch Permit(MDP) receipt, if not submitted penalty shall be charged as per the joint secretary, Energy Department letter no. Energy26 PPT 2022 dtd:26.04.2022
KPCL shall recover the Income tax etc., at the prevailing applicable rates

The successful bidder should strictly adhere & ensure the minimum wages Act to the labours prevailing as per the Govt. rules & regulations. The bidder should maintain register of labour deployed and wages paid for the workers and shall produce the documents whenever called for by the competent authority and remittance towards PF shall commensurate with the labour component for the work involved
Contractor should have independents PF Code. The Contractor shall remit PF of labourers to contractors permanent PF code Number only and Not to the KPCL PF Sub Code
In case the dates notified above are declared as holiday, the immediate next working day shall be reckoned
If the contractor makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection
Further details of the work can be obtained in the office of the Executive Engineer (RTM), KPCL, RTPS, Shaktinagar - 584170, during office hours
The tender Notification along with Blank Tender Form will be accessible in the e-procurement website (www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in).
Aspiring Bidders/Contractors who have not obtained the user ID and Password for participating in e-procurement may now obtain the same from the website www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in
Corrigendum/modification/corrections, if any, will be published in the website only
In case the agency fails to execute the work properly, engineer may entrust the work to the other agency at the cost and risk of original agency
The tender shall be valid for 180 days from the last date of submission of bid.
All labourers Police verification is to be carried out by the contractor & same to besubmitted for gate passes and cost is also to be borne by the contractor

In case of death of a contractor after executing the agreement/ commencement of the work, his legal heir (to be intimated at the time of execution of agreement by the successful contractor), if any eligible registered contractor and willing, can execute the complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work after obtaining approval competent authority

Contract Performance Guarantee: The successful bidder has to furnish DD/NEFT from Nationalised/Scheduled Bank or e-Bank Guarantee from the banks which are integrated with NeSL for an amount equivalent to 5% of the contract value with an appropriate validity period within 20 days from the date of issue of Letter of intent (LOI). The e-Bank Guarantee (e-BG)/DD shall be furnished in the prescribed format only. The work Performance shall be of 12 Months after completing the work. The total contract period is 16 Months. The Contract Performance Guarantee (CPG) will be released only after the satisfactory completion of total contract. Maintenance period shall be 12 months from the date of completion of work.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor (at least 90% of the contract value) atleast one Similar/Civil work of value not less than Rs. 33.68 Lakhs (Inclusive of GST) in the precedingFive financial years (ie., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). The certificate issued by the Competent Authority not below the rank of Chief Engineer in case of KPCLworks and not below the rank of Executive Engineer and equivalent in case of other Government Organizations is to be uploaded in the Technical bid. (Work done of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of financial year 2026-27).

The Intending bidder in his name should have achieved in At least two financial years an average annual Financial Turnover of value not less than Rs.67.36 Lakhs (Inclusive of GST) during the preceding five completed financial years (i.e 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). The bidder shall submit the certified copy of Turnover certificate duly certified by the chartered Accountant for the respective two years & the same shall be uploaded along with the technical bid. (Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of financial year 2026-27).

technicalCriterionList.description: Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria in Para no. (1, 2 and 3) of PQRs, will only be qualified if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under Assessed available tender capacity (AxNx2.5-B) should be greater than the amount put to tender were, A Maximum value of works executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to 2026 27) price level taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited. B Value of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 4 Months (0.33 year)

I/we declares that EMD has not been forfeited and None of my contracts have been terminated/foreclosed on account of default in KPCL or elsewhere during the past 3 (Three) years. My/our offer has no conditions contravening the commercial conditions of the bid. I/we have studied the site conditions, labour conditions and read the Bid documents and related matters carefully and diligently and that he has submitted the bid having studied understood and accepted the full implications of the agreement. I/we shall pay fair and reasonable wages, which shall not be less than the minimum wages fixed by GOK to the labours/workmen employed in the contract. I/we have accepted the condition that KPCL reserves the right to foreclose the contract at any point of time without assigning any reason

The intending bidder should have executed the work involving PCC/RCC of quantity not less than 546.84 Cum in any one year for a continuous period of 12 months i.e. (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). The certificate issued by the Competent Authority not below the rank of Chief Engineer in case of KPCL works and not below the rank of Executive Engineer and equivalent in case other Government Organizations is to be uploaded in the technical bid.

Liquid assets availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs. 20.21 Lakhs Credit lines/letter of credit/certificates from Nationalized Banks/Scheduled Banks for meeting the fund requirement etc., shall be uploaded.
Any reputed individual/Company having valid KPWD contractor registration certificate of Class III & above are eligible for participation for which scanned copy of the same shall be uploaded

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Providing CC Pathway concreting in between Railway Tracks in Marshalling yard at RTPS

itemList.description: Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means for all works & depth upto 3 m, as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including Cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenaces required to complete the work ( In all kinds of soils Depth upto 3 m

Providing rubble and Pond Ash/bottom ash filling in layers of 250 to 300mm including cost of all materilas, machinery, labour, watering, ramming etc., with all lead and all lifts. (Pond ash/Bottom ash will be issued departmentally at Rs. 1/tonne)

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete Mix 1:3:6 Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications
